title: New Teen Titans #2 DC 1984 Baxter Search for Raven George Perez Marv Wolfman
condition_description: Creasing and light wear on the black cover, small chip at bottom left corner, toning on the back cover. See photos.
description:
The New Teen Titans #2 (October 1984), DC Comics - Volume 2 Baxter-paper series. "The Search for Raven!" Written by Marv Wolfman, cover and art by George Perez. $1.25 cover price.

Back cover: Intellivision Bump 'n' Jump video game ad.

Condition: creasing and light wear on the black cover (shows easily), small chip at the bottom left corner, and toning on the back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
